page.overview:
Who is Ruth Cole?

Ruth Cole is an Assamite antitribu and a member of The Dead Gypsies, a nomadic Sabbat pack. She is also a member of the Black Hand and secretly serves an infernal master.

Before her Embrace, Ruth was a high school dropout working as a full-time waitress. Her mortal life ended the night The Dead Gypsies rolled into the diner where she was cleaning up. Returning from a particularly bloody War Party, the pack desperately needed replacements. Ruth, along with three men and one other woman, was taken to a local graveyard and subjected to the Creation Rites. Much to the pack's surprise, all five recruits survived the ordeal.

The newly created vampires were immediately sent against a Camarilla coterie that had caused The Dead Gypsies a great deal of trouble in previous years. Ruth and two others survived the mission, though the other two have since been destroyed, leaving Ruth as the only remaining member of her recruitment batch. Three years ago, acting on the advice of her pack's ductus, Harry Reese, the Black Hand formally accepted Ruth into its ranks. It was through her connections in the Black Hand that she ultimately met her current infernal master and began walking the Path of Evil Revelations.

Investments: 1 point of Body Armor, Kiss of Hades, Invisibility to Animals
